args: [ -n "$TFE_TOKEN" ] || TFE_TOKEN=$(python3 -c "import json,os;print(json.load(open(os.path.expanduser('~/.terraform.d/credentials.tfrc.json')))['credentials']['app.terraform.io']['token'])" 2>/dev/null); export TFE_TOKEN; exec terraform-mcp-server stdio
[ -n "$GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN" ] || GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN=$(gh auth token); export GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN; exec github-mcp-server stdio
